concept: 主动阻塞：阻塞子带将军或捉子
question_cn: 为什么「带威胁的阻塞」（如阻塞格同时将军）比「静态阻塞」更具战术价值？
question_en: Why is a blockade that comes with a threat, such as check, more valuable than a static blockade?

options.text_cn: 带威胁的阻塞子更难被吃掉，因为对方必须先应将
options.text_en: The blocking piece is harder to capture because the opponent must answer the check first

options.text_cn: 带威胁的阻塞强迫对方立即应对，使阻塞效果在对方来不及反应前就已生效，同时赢得额外战术利益
options.text_en: A threatening blockade forces an immediate response, making the block effective before the opponent can react while also gaining an extra tactical benefit

options.text_cn: 静态阻塞会让对方有时间绕路，带威胁才能让对方彻底无法移动
options.text_en: A static blockade gives the opponent time to take a detour, while a threatening one prevents all movement

options.text_cn: 带威胁的阻塞可以节省子力，不需要额外的支援
options.text_en: A threatening blockade saves material and requires no additional support

explanation_cn: 「强制性」是阻塞有效的前提。将军迫使对方当即应将，无法腾出手来消除阻塞子；捉子迫使对方救子。相比之下，静态阻塞（无威胁）可能被对方下一手吃掉或绕开，效果大打折扣。带威胁的阻塞=阻塞效果+战术威胁，是最高效的阻塞形式。
explanation_en: A blockade is most effective when it is forcing. Check obliges the opponent to respond immediately, leaving no time to remove or bypass the blocking piece; an attack on a piece similarly demands attention. A static blockade may simply be captured or bypassed on the next move. A threatening blockade combines the restriction with an immediate tactical threat.
